en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a European street with a prominent brick post office building on the left, featuring ornate architecture, a clock, and flagpole. The street, identified in the caption as Döbelner Strasse, slopes gently upward and is lined with multi‑story houses. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and horse‑drawn carts are visible on the street. The lower margin bears a printed red caption and publisher information.
